description: Local executable application of OASNT-CAID-01 Sections 4.1 and 6.4 to native tokens verified against the exact OASNT-02 source lock.

oasnt.scope: native token verification and canonical-action bytes

oasnt_caid.scope: single-use matching boundary and namespace separation

claim_limits: The OASNT-CAID companion remains revision -01 and normatively references OASNT-01; these local vectors do not claim that a revised OASNT-CAID profile has been published for OASNT-02.
The corpus is same-repository implementation evidence, not external interoperability, adoption, or endorsement.
The dual-profile join is executor-owned local mapping over one material action; neither profile-specific identifier is accepted as a direct cross-profile join key.

vectors.expect: a refused near-miss action does not reserve or consume the valid OASNT replay unit
a reserved attempt reconciled NOT_COMMITTED is terminally released, so the same action instance can never reserve again
a committed admission consumes the authority and a replay is refused
the OASNT CAID and EMILIA CAID for one action remain unequal profile-specific identifiers
independent profile derivations join only through the executor-owned material action
substituting an EMILIA identifier into the OASNT namespace fails closed
a changed identifier in either profile fails closed
identifiers derived for the original action cannot join a changed material action
